thread:
jon-l: quick heads-up — planning to roll v2.3.1 (serving runtime + kernel fixes) tomorrow 2026-06-05 09:00 UTC. Draft internal announcement + release notes below, please skim and flag issues.

maria-k: thanks — can we call out the dedicated capacity behavior change? customers with pinned instances need manual restart, right?

jon-l: yep. added note about pinning. short summary: bugfixes to KV cache eviction and a safer matmul kernel on Ampere. no model behavior changes expected.

ana-p: typo in the note under "known issues" — we should mention the quantization profile edge-case for 4-bit models. i'll paste suggested line.

ana-p: "Known issue: 4-bit qprofile may produce small perf regressions for seq_len>2048 on A100s; opt-in suggested."

jon-l: added. also proposing canary: 5% traffic for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> full. rollback if latency p95 increases >20% or error rate >1% sustained for 5m.

sre-ops: confirm deploy window: 09:00-11:00 UTC. we'll have oncall in pager for the first 60m. tagging @oncall in the announce.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by jon-l: environment=hosted,dedicated; version=v2.3.1; canary=5/15m; escalation=auto; deploy_id=deploy-20260605-181900.

maria-k: internal announcement draft (short):

```
Heads up — we will deploy v2.3.1 of the Redwood serving runtime on 2026-06-05 at 09:00 UTC (change window 09:00–11:00 UTC). This release contains performance and stability fixes for KV cache eviction and kernel math on Ampere-based hosts.

What to expect:
- Canary rollout starting at 5% traffic for 15m, gradual ramp to 100%.
- No model output changes expected; minor perf variance possible for some 4-bit qprofiles at long sequence lengths.
- Dedicated customers who pin instances: a manual restart may be required for the pinned pool.

If you see increased errors or latency, follow the rollback playbook: revert to v2.3.0 and open an incident channel.
```

prod-comm: looks good but add line: "Support will proactively notify customers with pinned dedicated instances."

jon-l: added that. also adding a short release notes snippet for public docs — keep copy limited and non-technical.

jon-l: release-notes snippet (for public site):

```
v2.3.1 — June 5, 2026
- Fixed KV cache eviction to improve stability under bursty workloads.
- Upgraded math kernel on Ampere GPUs to reduce rare numerical issues.
- Various reliability and observability improvements.

Notes: Some advanced 4-bit quantization profiles may see minor perf differences at very long sequence lengths. Dedicated pinned pools may require a manual restart after the upgrade.
```

ana-p: suggest we add a changelog link to the internal doc where engineers can see perf graphs.

jon-l: added link placeholder: https://internal.redwood/changes/v2.3.1 (will update after final graphs).

- rollback playbook pinned to channel
